about: Generator inputs for cherbourg.pmtiles and cherbourg-depth.pmtiles, the TCP1 golden fixture: one tile per zoom z6-14 over Cherbourg harbour (z14 tile 8118/5580). Rebuild with scripts/make_chart_fixture.py; pinned sources, rules, build id, time and the builder label the golden was frozen with (by tactician tools/charts, 2026-11-07) give the same bytes from the same cached inputs.
